## streamSize(root0) ⇒ <code>AsyncGenerator&lt;Readable, void, unknown&gt;</code>

## streamSizeTransform(root0) ⇒
Creates a passthrough `Transform` that reports cumulative byte size.

**Kind**: global function

| root0 | Options object. |
